evidence.decision: Prioritizes likely item actions with visible alternatives, preserves unavailable-context versus ordinary-menu differences and scopes destructive ordering by platform.
evidence.artifact: Requires menu tree, selection/availability rules, preview scope and discoverable alternate routes.
evidence.transformation: File Rename gains main/visible access while unavailable sharing disappears and three-level export nesting becomes one predictive submenu.
evidence.verification: Tests single/multiple selection, ineligible objects, opening position and comparable items; fails hidden-only actions, wrong targets and unusable height.
evidence.applicability: Explicitly preserves Mac Cut/Copy/Paste dimmed exception, mobile edit/context exclusivity, visionOS control clearance and Watch absence.
evidence.handoffs: Uses Edit menus for selected-content editing and Menus for common command structure.
evidence.distinctiveness: Object scope, preview clipping, contextual eligibility and supplemental access are concrete context-menu decisions.
